title: SpaceX, Other Mega IPOs Denied Fast Index Entry by S&P
summary: S&P Dow Jones Indices has decided to maintain its current rules for including mega-cap IPOs in their indexes, after a consultation process. This decision means companies like SpaceX will not receive fast-track entry to S&P indices regardless of their size or valuation at IPO.
problem_solved: Clarifies the criteria and timeline for how mega-cap companies can be included in major stock market indices.
why_valuable: Provides transparency for institutional investors and companies about index inclusion rules, which affect billions of dollars in passive investment flows.
